Emily will be graduating from Hawai’i Pacific University in Spring of 2027 with a B.S. in Marine Biology and as a member of the Honors Program. During her time as an undergraduate, she volunteered as an education docent for the New York Marine Rescue Center, Long Island Aquarium, and Waikiki Aquarium. She also worked as an intern at the New York Marine Rescue Center hospital as part the rescue team, helping rescue and rehabilitate injured sea turtles and marine mammals. Currently, she is contributing to research projects in the lab at Hawai’i Pacific University to gain hands-on experience in scientific research. In addition, Emily is very passionate about environmental conservation and public education. She is conducting her own study focused on cold-stunned sea turtles, investigating patterns in environment conditions for stranding cases.
